meaning:
προ-ϋπ-άρχω
[in LXX: Job 42:18* ;]
1. to be beforehand in.
2. to be before or previously: with ptcp., Luk.23:12, Act.8:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.
But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,
